newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent slips back under US pressure.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent slips back under US pressure.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures were weaker on Monday amid thin activity and traders said weakness in U.S. markets was the main reason prices were slipping lower.
Feb Brent was 19 cents a barrel weaker at $23.27 at 1543 GMT while Jan gas oil was $4 a tonne down at $211.00.
"The pressure is coming from the U.S.," one IPE dealer said. "There is a bit of trade selling and (IPE) gas oil is giving no support."
NYMEX crude was 31 cents a barrel lower at $24.77, as Russian and European arbitrage cargoes of crude and gas oil headed westwards into north America.
Jan and Feb gas oil were trading flat to each other at the IPE, but dealers said the disappearance of the recent backwardation in the market was not especially significant.
